verdict.rationale: Microsoft's privacy FAQ documents an explicit setting to opt out of using conversation activity for model training (copilot-docs-35), but hands-on community reports contradict this for at least one major surface—Word for Mac users report Copilot appears with 'no way of turning it off' and uncertainty over whether documents are silently used for training (copilot-comm-3, copilot-comm-6), suggesting the opt-out is inconsistent across Copilot's many integrations. Missing for 10: consistent opt-out controls across all Copilot surfaces (Office apps, browser, mobile), independent verification that toggling the setting actually stops data collection, and clarity on telemetry beyond just 'training' use.
